item.title: Jugraj Singh Hails Fan Support, Odisha’s Role And Team Focus Ahead Of Final Leg Of Men’s Hockey India League
item.description: The Shrachi Bengal Tigers: Shrachi Bengal Tigers captain Jugraj Singh expressed confidence and optimism ahead of the final leg of the Men’s Hockey India League (HIL) 2026, praising the growing fan support across venues and highlighting Odisha’s pivotal role in promoting the sport in India.

item.title: Shreyanka Patil Delighted With Maiden T20 Five-For as RCB Stay Unbeaten in WPL 2026
item.description: RCB all-rounder Shreyanka Patil celebrated her first T20 five-wicket haul after taking 5/23 against Gujarat Giants, helping Bengaluru extend their unbeaten run in the 2026 Women’s Premier League.

item.title: Arthur Doren Praises Fan Support, World-class Facilities Ahead Of Final Leg Of Men’s Hockey India League
item.description: Arthur Van Doren: Vedanta Kalinga Lancers captain Arthur Van Doren expressed optimism and appreciation for the growing stature of the Men’s Hockey India League (HIL) 2026, highlighting strong local support, the league’s international character, and the high-quality venues hosting the tournament.

item.title: UP Warriorz vs Mumbai Indians, Match 10, WPL 2026, Who will win today UPW-W vs MI-W match?
item.description: UP Warriorz Women and Mumbai Indians Women will take on each other in the next game of the WPL 2026 on Saturday.

item.title: Amit Rohidas Highlights Odisha’s Hockey Culture And League’s Role In Player Development Ahead Of Final Leg Of Men’s HIL
item.description: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda: Accord Tamil Nadu Dragons defender Amit Rohidas praised the vibrant hockey culture in Odisha and underlined the importance of the Men’s Hockey India League (HIL) 2026 in shaping players for success at the national and international levels.

item.title: Delhi Capitals vs Royal Challengers Bengaluru, Match 11, WPL 2026, Who will win today DC-W vs RCB-W match?
item.description: Delhi Capitals Women and Royal Challengers Bengaluru Women will lock horns on Saturday at Dr. DY Patil Sports Academy at 7:30 PM IST.

item.title: Mensik Beats Baez To Clinch Auckland Crown
item.description: Pablo Carreno Busta: Jakub Mensik clinched the Auckland Classic title after defeating Sebastian Baez 6-3 7-6(7) in the final, producing another composed performance to cap an outstanding week at the tournament.

item.title: I Still Can't Figure Out How Selectors Went With Inglis Ahead Of Webster In Ashes: Ponting
item.description: New Delhi: Former Australia captain Ricky Ponting has questioned the Ashes selection calls, saying he is still unable to understand why Josh Inglis was preferred over Beau Webster during the series.

item.title: Mirra Andreeva Wins Adelaide International, Builds Momentum for Australian Open
item.description: Mirra Andreeva claimed the Adelaide International title with a dominant win over Victoria Mboko, rising to No. 7 ahead of the Australian Open.

item.title: Kohli, Kuldeep Visit Shree Mahakaleshwar Temple, Attend Bhasma Aarti
item.description: Shree Mahakaleshwar Temple: Former India captain and batting stalwart Virat Kohli, along with spinner Kuldeep Yadav and fielding coach T Dilip, visited the Shree Mahakaleshwar Temple in Ujjain on Saturday to seek blessings of Lord Shiva and also attended the Bhasma Aarti on Saturday.
